input.prompt:
ORIGINAL special unlockable tower design for a colorful post-apocalyptic mobile tower-defense game. This tower is unlocked by activating an overgrown radio relay / salvage secret. It must be original and fit a playful casual plant-defense cartoon world.

Design concept: SALVAGE BLOOM TOWER — a squat improvised eco-machine built from reclaimed scrap and living plants. Circular rusty salvage base, thick roots wrapping around metal panels, a central teal energy core, two small articulated plant-vine arms collecting nearby scrap, one flower-like emitter that periodically releases a teal-green recycling pulse. No guns, no realistic military hardware, no sci-fi sleekness. Looks handmade, funny, useful, and slightly magical.

Gameplay visual role: support/economy tower that recycles defeated-enemy scrap into small Essence/energy bonuses and occasionally emits a brief buff pulse to nearby plants. Silhouette must be distinct from normal towers and readable on a phone.

Create a clean source sheet on warm off-white background:
1) final active idle hero pose,
2) folded/inactive deployment pose,
3) activation pose with teal core lighting up,
4) recycling pulse pose,
5) small upgrade visual variant with extra vine collector.
Keep same top-down/3/4 camera and consistent proportions. Chunky casual-game cartoon, clean outlines, saturated colors, soft cel shading, original IP. No text, no logo, no labels, no UI.
